description: Type one value of a stored credential (username, password, a fresh TOTP code, or a named extra field) into a field you found with browz_snapshot. Browz types it itself, paced like a person; the result says only that it was filled. Refused unless the tab (and any frame around the field) is on one of the credential's sites over https, and a password or code goes only into a password field (a code also into an autocomplete=one-time-code field). After a password or code is filled, browz_evaluate and browz_screenshot are refused on this profile until that tab loads another page; browz_snapshot keeps working and hides the value.

field.description: username, password, totp, or the name of one of the credential's extra fields

human.description: Type with the profile's human pacing (default true); false types at once

ref.description: The field's ref from browz_snapshot, e.g. e12

submit.description: Press Enter in the field after filling it. Default false

targetId.description: Tab to use: a targetId from browz_tabs_list. Default: the first tab

name: browz_credential_fill
title: Fill a stored credential
